# FamilyBridge

> FamilyBridge is the iPhone and iPad app for families of someone with addiction. It takes a family from divided to united — before, during and after treatment — and connects them with the professionals who help them.

Families get on the same page with a private monthly Alignment Check (everyone answers privately; the family sees where it agrees and where it's split, never who said what), a family pact everyone signs, and "Before you say yes" — when the loved one asks one person for money, a ride or a place to stay, they see the family's agreed answer and the words to use, and the family is told. A weekly family program (short, CRAFT-informed lessons in English and Spanish) and guided family meetings keep everyone pulling in the same direction. A treatment plan keeps everything ready for the moment the loved one says yes, and the person in recovery can tell the family "I need help" in one tap. In early recovery, a trust ladder agreed by the whole family shows what rebuilds trust.

Families also share accountability (money requests with family votes and receipts, meetings, appointments, medications), boundaries, a relapse response plan and a family chat with a respect filter. AI coaching (Claude by Anthropic, only with the user's permission) helps with hard conversations: an AI Coach, Live Coaching during calls, conversation practice with an AI playing the loved one, intervention-letter feedback, and Family Insights, which spots readiness windows. SOS shows 911, 988 and overdose steps first, then reaches the family's professional or a 24-hour messaging session with a certified interventionist.

Professionals (interventionists, treatment centers, therapists, coaches, sober living, IOP) work alongside families with consent-based sharing, a caseload, handoffs between levels of care and white label.

Pricing: the app is free, including the Alignment Check, family pact, Before you say yes, family meetings, treatment plan, trust ladder, every accountability tool and the first three program lessons. Family Plus ($19.99/month) adds the full family program, every AI feature and a 24-hour SOS session each billing cycle, for the whole family. Professional plans start at $149/month. FamilyBridge is a support platform, not a medical, mental health, treatment, emergency, or crisis service.

## Important limitations

FamilyBridge does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, guarantee recovery, or predict an individual's outcome. AI-assisted features organize information the family chose to share and suggest things for people to consider. Each person's Alignment Check answers are private. Professionals see only the areas a parent or partner shares, and every view is logged.

For immediate danger in the United States, call 911. For a mental health or suicide crisis, call or text 988.

## About

FamilyBridge was founded by Matt Brown, a certified addiction interventionist with more than 20 years of experience and long-term personal recovery (Freedom Interventions, LLC). Contact: matt@freedominterventions.com
